labs.title: Agentic Cloud Security Essentials
labs.description: Architect enterprise-grade defenses for autonomous AI agents: Zero-Trust identity brokering, L7 MCP tool firewalls, Firecracker microVM sandboxing, eBPF telemetry, and NIST/ISO/OWASP governance.

labs.title: Zero-Trust Architecture
labs.description: A security model assuming all users, devices, and agents are hostile. Enforce mutual attestation, least privilege, and continuous verification.

labs.title: Threat Modeling Practical Guide
labs.description: Architect enterprise threat models using STRIDE, DFD trust boundaries, DREAD/CVSS v4 scoring, and automated Threat-Model-as-Code with pytm.

labs.title: Security Engineering Fundamentals
labs.description: Understand the core principles of security engineering and how to apply them to modern infrastructure and workload boundaries.

labs.title: NMAP Practical Auditing Labs
labs.description: Network reconnaissance, service discovery, open port auditing, and banner grabbing techniques for security engineers.

labs.title: Ethical Hacker Practical Lab
labs.description: Hands-on fundamentals of ethical hacking, penetration testing workflows, vulnerability assessment, and defense validation.
